content.title: What channel is Thunder vs Lakers on TV tonight? Time, NBA schedule, injury report
content.text: Updated April 7, 2026, 7:47 p.m. CTThe OKC Thunder will face the Los Angeles Lakers on the road at 9:30 p.m. CT Tuesday.OKC (62-16) cruised to a 146-111 home win over the Utah Jazz on Sunday. Jalen Williams has been ruled out due to right hamstring injury management.Los Angeles (50-28) fell short in a 134-128 road loss to the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday. The Lakers will be without Luka Doncic (left hamstring strain), Austin Reaves (left oblique muscle strain) and Marcus Smart (right ankle contusion).Here's everything you need to know about Tuesday's game between the Thunder and Lakers:Order our new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleWhat time is Thunder vs Lakers game tonight?Date: Tuesday, April 7Time: 9:30 p.m. CTWhere: Crypto.com Arena in Los AngelesWatch Thunder vs Lakers live on FuboWhat channel is OKC Thunder vs Los Angeles Lakers on tonight?TV: FanDuel Sports NetworkHow to watch online: Fubo (free trial)Thunder vs Lakers predictions, picksJustin Martinez: OKC 119, Los Angeles 94This is a bad matchup for Los Angeles, which was proven in its 43-point loss to OKC on Thursday. The Lakers struggled to take care of the basketball and slow down the pace due to the Thunder's turnover-forcing defense. And they also didn't have a ton of options to throw at Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, especially with Marcus Smart sidelined. Now, Los Angeles won't have Luka Doncic or Austin Reaves in Tuesday's rematch either. Even without Jalen Williams, OKC should win this game.Thunder vs Lakers betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Monday, April 6Odds: Thunder by 15.5Over/under: 222.5Moneyline: OKC -1600 | Los Angeles +850Thunder vs Lakers injury updatesThunder: Thomas Sorber (right ACL surgical recovery) is out. Jalen Williams (right hamstring injury management) is out.Lakers: Luka Doncic (left hamstring strain) is out. LeBron James (left foot injury management) is questionable. Austin Reaves (left oblique muscle strain) is out.
